messages.text: How can i pull my past conversation

A copy of the whole conversation gets emailed to you once the chat closes, to the address on the ticket, and you can reply to that email to reach us again.

If you mean an older chat from before, I'd need the email address you used so I can have the team pull it up.
I was talking to Sarah

That's me, Sarah. This chat starts fresh though, so I can't see what we covered last time.

What's the email you used? I can have the earlier transcript pulled up for you. Or just tell me what it was about and I'll pick it back up from here.
(email hidden)
Handed to the team · No tool to retrieve past chat transcripts.

Thanks. I can't pull an older transcript up myself, so I've passed it to the team to send to (email hidden) They're offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the copy comes to your email, so no need to wait here.

In the meantime, if you tell me what it was about, I can carry on with it right now.
We were talking about the use of the extra 4dsky antenna and if it helps your earnings
Read the 4dsky airsquitter page
Searched the catalog · 4DSKY Airsquitter antenna

Right, the 4DSKY. What the listing actually says: every unit comes with the 1090 MHz antenna, and the bonus-antenna variants add a second one. More coverage of the sky means more aircraft messages, and points follow coverage, so a second antenna can help, but the listing doesn't put a number on the uplift and I won't invent one.

Placement matters more than anything: clear sky view, rooftop or attic.

Standard USA is $985.83 and in stock. Where are you installing, and which country?
So how long would i have to wait for the extra antenna

The bonus-antenna bundle shows no stock in the US right now, and the listing carries no restock date, so I won't guess one. The E. + NZ bonus bundle is available. Canada/LATAM/AU is also out.

If you're in the US, I've asked Georges for the restock date on that bundle. The team's offline now and picks it up at 10am ET tomorrow, and the answer comes to your email.

Which country are you installing in?
Usa asap
Handed to the team · No restock date available for the US bonus-antenna variant.

For asap in the US, the one that's actually buyable today is the Standard Antenna (USA) at $985.83, in stock and shipping within 5 business days: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/4dsky-airsquitter

The U. bonus bundle is out of stock with no date on it. I've put that question to Georges, he picks it up at 10am ET tomorrow and the date comes to your email.

Want me to set up the standard one so it's ready to check out?
I found out i would earn more from the dual antenna

Fair enough, and that lines up with the idea that more coverage means more points. I just can't put a number on it from the listing.

Either way, the US dual-antenna bundle is out of stock and I don't have a restock date. Georges has that question and comes back to you at 10am ET tomorrow by email.

So it's wait for his date, or take the standard USA unit now and look at a second antenna later. Which way do you want to go?
Can you have him update me

Yes. It's with him already, and your email (email hidden) is on it, so the restock date for the US dual-antenna bundle comes to you there. He's offline tonight and picks it up at 10am ET tomorrow.

If anything moves before then, or you decide you'd rather take the standard unit, just write back here.
Ok

Sounds good. You'll hear from Georges on that restock date.
